items.title: Leaf Rubbing Activity
items.alt: A tidy small flat lay shows one real oval veined leaf beside a white paper sheet with a simple green leaf-vein crayon rubbing and two short wax crayons, complete paper corners and leaf stalk, no text or hands.

items.title: Leaf with a Water Drop
items.alt: One large glossy shield-shaped green taro-style leaf curves gently inward with a single clear rounded water drop resting near its central vein, crisp radiating ribs and complete curved petiole, no other props.
